turns.text: quick q can you build me a study + meal prep plan for this week. exam got moved to dec 6 bc of overtime so i have like 2 weeks. i work 1pm to 11:30pm mon-fri rn, 10 hr swings so weekdays are cooked. want to use my practice-test app and the secondhand study guide w/ tabbed chapters. also my laundry is running in the unit rn so i'm doing this while the washer goes lol

Happy to. With 1 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. shifts, your usable study windows are mornings before work and maybe a short block after you get home. Quick questions so I don't guess:

1. What time do you usually wake up?
2. Any weak chapters in the guide you want to prioritize?
3. Do you want meals for weekday dinners only, or lunches too?
wake up around 9. weak spots are subnetting and port numbers. need lunch + dinner break food, i eat at work. keep sunday night free pls, i have my co-op game with the squad. dont touch that slot

Got it. Sunday night stays untouched. Here's the week:

**Study (mornings, ~9:45 to 11:45 a.m., Mon-Fri)**
- Mon: subnetting chapter in the tabbed guide, then 20 practice-app questions on it
- Tue: port numbers. Make a flash list from the guide tabs, then a short app quiz
- Wed: mixed practice-test in the app, timed. Mark misses with a tab
- Thu: redo only the missed questions, then re-read the tabbed sections for them
- Fri: full-length timed practice test in the app
- Sat: review Friday's misses for 60-90 min, nothing more
- Sun: today, a light 30-45 min skim of your tabs before the game

**Meal prep (today, while the laundry runs)**
- Cook one big batch of rice plus two proteins, e.g. chicken thighs and beans
- Portion 10 containers: 5 lunches, 5 dinner-break meals
- Chop veggies and a sauce so you can mix and match
- Midweek top-up Wednesday morning: a quick second batch of whichever ran low

**Tips**
- Put the hardest topic first, when you're freshest
- After the shift, skip studying and sleep, since you're wrapped late
- Keep a one-page cheat sheet of ports and subnet steps to glance at on breaks

Want a tl;dr checklist version or a grocery list?

**Checklist**
- Today: skim tabs 30-45 min, cook rice + 2 proteins, portion 10 containers, game night free
- Mon: subnetting + 20 app questions
- Tue: ports flash list + quiz
- Wed: timed mixed test, top-up meal prep
- Thu: redo misses
- Fri: full timed practice test
- Sat: review misses 60-90 min

Good luck on Dec 6!
